title: U.S. economy added 57,000 jobs in June, less than expected; unemployment rate at 4.2%
title_zh: 美国6月新增就业岗位5.7万个，低于预期；失业率为 4.2%
text: Nonfarm payrolls were expected to rise by 115,000 in June while the unemployment rate held steady at 4.3%.
zh: 6 月份非农就业人数预计增加 11.5 万人，失业率稳定在 4.3%。

title: Rivian raises 2026 delivery outlook while Lucid misses Wall Street expectations for second quarter
title_zh: Rivian 上调 2026 年交付预期，而 Lucid 未达到华尔街对第二季度的预期
text: Rivian is increasing its delivery outlook to between 65,000 and 70,000 EVs, up from 62,000 to 67,000 units.
zh: Rivian 将电动汽车的交付量预期从 62,000 辆上调至 67,000 辆，上调至 65,000 辆至 70,000 辆。

title: Meta’s push into cloud computing means Wall Street has to prepare for lower margins
title_zh: Meta进军云计算意味着华尔街必须为利润率下降做好准备
text: Meta appears poised to enter the cloud computing market in an effort to monetize its massive AI infrastructure.
zh: Meta 似乎准备进入云计算市场，以期通过其庞大的人工智能基础设施获利。

title: Jeff Bezos' family office backed five AI startups in June
title_zh: 杰夫·贝索斯 (Jeff Bezos) 的家族办公室在 6 月份投资了五家人工智能初创公司
text: Bezos Expeditions is now the most active family office investor thus far this year, per data from Fintrx.
zh: 根据 Fintrx 的数据，贝索斯探险队目前是今年迄今为止最活跃的家族办公室投资者。

title: Most prediction market contracts have low volume, leaving users exposed to volatility and bots
title_zh: 大多数预测市场合约的交易量都很低，使用户面临波动和机器人的影响
text: Prediction market volume has grown exponentially but several markets never make it over $10,000.
zh: 预测市场规模呈指数增长，但有几个市场从未超过 10,000 美元。

title: High-end camping and a capital raise: AutoCamp is banking on summer travel to fuel growth
title_zh: 高端露营和融资：AutoCamp 指望夏季旅行来推动增长
text: AutoCamp offers Airstream suites, polished cabins, fire pits, design-forward amenities and access to iconic outdoor destinations.
zh: AutoCamp 提供气流套房、精美的小屋、火坑、设计先进的设施，并可通往标志性的户外目的地。

title: Ford CEO wants level playing field with Toyota, GM imports as USMCA trade talks reopen
title_zh: 随着USMCA贸易谈判重新开启，福特首席执行官希望与丰田、通用汽车进口产品建立公平的竞争环境
text: Ford reports it assembled more than 2 million vehicles in the U.S. last year – more than any other auto manufacturer, including 311,000 units for export.
zh: 福特报告称，去年该公司在美国组装了超过 200 万辆汽车，比任何其他汽车制造商都多，其中包括 311,000 辆用于出口。

title: Jim Cramer's top 10 things to watch in the stock market Thursday
title_zh: 吉姆·克莱默 (Jim Cramer) 周四股市最值得关注的 10 件事
text: The June jobs report came in weak, and Palantir landed a big upgrade.
zh: 6 月份就业报告疲弱，Palantir 大幅升级。

title: Brookfield wants to build AI data centers in London’s answer to Wall Street
title_zh: 布鲁克菲尔德希望在伦敦建立人工智能数据中心，以回应华尔街
text: Brookfield's CEO said the firm is bringing data centers to London's Canary Wharf, as demand for AI infrastructure in the U.K. soars.
zh: Brookfield 首席执行官表示，随着英国对人工智能基础设施的需求飙升，该公司正在将数据中心迁至伦敦金丝雀码头。

title: ‘I don’t think I’ll make it to 80’: I’m 70 and single. Do I take out a reverse mortgage or a home-equity agreement?
title_zh: “我不认为我能活到 80 岁”：我已经 70 岁了，还是单身。我是否需要申请反向抵押贷款或房屋净值协议？
text: “I’m torn between these two options.”
zh: “我在这两个选择之间左右为难。”

title: ‘She wants him gone’: My friend took in a homeless man as a caretaker. After 10 years, how can she evict him?
title_zh: “她希望他离开”：我的朋友收留了一名无家可归的人作为看护人。十年了，她怎么能赶走他？
text: “He lived rent-free, helping her with health-related issues and other tasks.”
zh: “他免租居住，帮助她解决与健康相关的问题和其他任务。”

title: I’m a 35-year-old American living in Japan. How can I build long-term wealth without a 401(k) or Roth IRA?
title_zh: 我是一位住在日本的 35 岁美国人。如果没有 401(k) 或 Roth IRA，我如何才能积累长期财富？
text: “Some financial institutions limit services for customers with foreign addresses.”
zh: “一些金融机构限制为拥有外国地址的客户提供服务。”

title: Want to live longer in retirement? This one money move could add years to your life.
title_zh: 想在退休后活得更久吗？这一笔钱的举动可能会延长你的寿命。
text: A secure retirement portfolio acts like a health shield, calming market anxiety that can actually shorten life expectancy.
zh: 安全的退休投资组合就像健康盾牌，可以平息市场焦虑，而这种焦虑实际上会缩短预期寿命。

title: Is the stock market open tomorrow, or will it close early for the Fourth of July?
title_zh: 股市明天开市还是七月四日提前收市？
text: Since Independence Day falls on Saturday this year, here’s what to know about trading hours and mail delivery
zh: 由于今年的独立日是星期六，因此以下是有关交易时间和邮件投递的信息

title: ‘We are more likely to be living in poverty’: Social Security is a lifeline for women, so why are we ignored?
title_zh: “我们更有可能生活在贫困之中”：社会保障是女性的生命线，为何我们却被忽视？
text: “We are more likely to live longer, to live alone and to be caregivers.”
zh: “我们更有可能活得更久，独自生活并成为照顾者。”

title: Americans are paying record prices for steak. Here's why demand isn't cracking
title_zh: 美国人正在为牛排支付创纪录的价格。这就是需求没有增长的原因
text: Despite record beef prices, Americans aren't giving up steak. Consumers are treating beef as an affordable luxury and prioritizing it for special occasions.
zh: 尽管牛肉价格创历史新高，美国人并没有放弃牛排。消费者将牛肉视为一种负担得起的奢侈品，并在特殊场合优先考虑它。

title: SpaceX may emerge as ultimate blueprint for new wave of mega-cap IPOs
title_zh: SpaceX可能成为新一波大型IPO的最终蓝图
text: "It would not surprise me at all to see a similar dynamic play out with some of these [IPOs] set to come in the months ahead," the Kathmere Capital CIO says.
zh: Kathmere Capital 首席信息官表示：“如果在未来几个月内看到其中一些 [IPO] 出现类似的动态，我一点也不感到惊讶。”

title: Nvidia offers start-up customers chance to swap compute power for revenue share
title_zh: Nvidia 为初创客户提供以计算能力换取收入分成的机会
text: Nvidia says it will give start-ups the chance to swap access to compute power for a slice of future profits under a new program aimed at AI-focused firms.
zh: 英伟达表示，根据一项针对人工智能公司的新计划，它将为初创企业提供用计算能力来换取未来利润的机会。

title: AI agents will soon be able to match human traders, Robinhood CEO tells CNBC
title_zh: Robinhood 首席执行官告诉 CNBC，人工智能代理很快就能与人类交易员相匹配
text: Vlad Tenev spoke about the potential of AI agents in trading in an interview with CNBC.
zh: Vlad Tenev 在接受 CNBC 采访时谈到了人工智能代理在交易中的潜力。

title: U.S. won’t renew USMCA, opening door for negotiations with Canada and Mexico
title_zh: 美国不会续签USMCA，为与加拿大和墨西哥的谈判打开大门
text: President Donald Trump's "primary" issue with USMCA centers on America's trade deficits with Canada and Mexico, a senior administration official said.
zh: 一位高级政府官员表示，唐纳德·特朗普总统对《美墨加协定》的“主要”问题集中在美国与加拿大和墨西哥的贸易逆差上。

title: Russia’s neighbor Lithuania scraps constitutional ban on nuclear weapons. Here's why
title_zh: 俄罗斯的邻国立陶宛废除了核武器宪法禁令。这就是为什么
text: The decision comes shortly after lawmakers in Finland voted to lift its longstanding ban on nuclear weapons.
zh: 这一决定是在芬兰立法者投票解除其长期的核武器禁令后不久做出的。

title: Warsh faces multiple alternative inflation signs as Fed charts new course
title_zh: 随着美联储制定新方针，沃什面临多种替代通胀迹象
text: Warsh has said that inflation is a "choice." The same could also be true of how inflation is measured.
zh: 沃什曾表示，通货膨胀是一种“选择”。通货膨胀的衡量方式也可能如此。

title: This fund manager bought Nvidia and SK Hynix and sold software before others. His simple message on AI: ‘Follow the money.’
title_zh: 这位基金经理先于其他人购买了 Nvidia 和 SK Hynix，并出售了软件。他对人工智能的简单信息是：“追随金钱。”
text: Blue Whale Growth Fund manager exited software stocks before many others did.
zh: 蓝鲸成长基金经理先于许多人退出了软件股。

title: ‘There was a catch’: My doctor friend was outraged by his hospital’s fundraising tactics. Where do we draw the line?
title_zh: “有一个问题”：我的医生朋友对他医院的筹款策略感到愤怒。我们在哪里划清界限？
text: “This shocking program was exploiting doctors and the trust inherent in their relationships with patients.”
zh: “这个令人震惊的计划正在利用医生以及他们与患者关系中固有的信任。”

title: Warsh’s throwaway comment injects life into the debasement trade, for one day at least
title_zh: 沃什的一次性评论至少在一天内为贬低交易注入了活力
text: As much as new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh tried to refrain from steering markets, it looks like he did.
zh: 尽管新任美联储主席凯文·沃什试图克制自己对市场的引导，但看起来他确实做到了。

title: Tamera Mowry lists Bay Area house for $2.7 million as she prepares to build Napa Valley ‘dream home’
title_zh: 塔梅拉·莫里 (Tamera Mowry) 以 270 万美元挂牌湾区房屋，准备建造纳帕谷“梦想家园”
text: “Sister, Sister” star Tamera Mowry-Housley has listed her longtime California house for $2.7 million—months after revealing that she and her husband are in the process of building a new home in Napa Valley.
zh: 《姐姐，姐姐》明星塔梅拉·莫里-豪斯利 (Tamera Mowry-Housley) 以 270 万美元的价格挂牌出售她在加州的长期住宅，几个月前她透露和丈夫正在纳帕谷建造新房。

title: After eight years, Google loses final appeal against $4.7 billion European Union fine
title_zh: 八年后，谷歌在针对欧盟 47 亿美元罚款的最终上诉中败诉
text: The Court of Justice of the European Union ruled to uphold its fine against Google over alleged anti-competition practices
zh: 欧盟法院裁定维持对谷歌涉嫌反竞争行为的罚款

title: OpenAI reportedly considers handing 5% stake to the government. Here’s why the AI lab would consider that move.
title_zh: 据报道，OpenAI 考虑将 5% 的股份交给政府。这就是人工智能实验室会考虑采取这一举措的原因。
text: Bringing the government on board as an equity partner may serve to dilute some of the criticism of the AI industry that has developed momentum in recent months.
zh: 让政府作为股权合作伙伴加入可能有助于淡化对近几个月来势头强劲的人工智能行业的一些批评。

title: MSCI Extends Review on Indonesia ‘Emerging Market’ Status - The Diplomat – Asia-Pacific
title_zh: MSCI 延长对印度尼西亚“新兴市场”地位的审查 - The Diplomat – Asia-Pacific
text: MSCI Extends Review on Indonesia ‘Emerging Market’ Status The Diplomat – Asia-Pacific
zh: MSCI 延长对印度尼西亚“新兴市场”地位的审查 The Diplomat – Asia-Pacific

title: Is China’s High-Quality Investment Output Economically Viable? - Carnegie Endowment for International Peace
title_zh: 中国的高质量投资产出在经济上是否可行？ - 卡内基国际和平基金会
text: Is China’s High-Quality Investment Output Economically Viable? Carnegie Endowment for International Peace
zh: 中国的高质量投资产出在经济上是否可行？卡内基国际和平基金会

title: Google loses fight over record $4.7 billion EU antitrust fine
title_zh: 欧盟反垄断罚款创纪录 47 亿美元 谷歌败诉
text: In 2018, the European Commission slapped Google with the record-breaking penalty on the grounds that it abused Android's mobile dominance.
zh: 2018年，欧盟委员会以谷歌滥用Android移动主导地位为由对其处以创纪录的处罚。

title: Tank maker KNDS postpones IPO amid market struggles for defense
title_zh: 坦克制造商 KNDS 在市场防御斗争中推迟 IPO
text: Shareholders of the Amsterdam-based company have decided the process to IPO will proceed "upon the return of more favorable market conditions," KNDS said.
zh: KNDS 表示，这家总部位于阿姆斯特丹的公司的股东已决定“在市场条件恢复更有利的情况下”继续进行 IPO。

title: Apple plans five new iPhones through 2027, eyes Chinese-made chips amid foldable push, reports say
title_zh: 报道称，苹果计划到 2027 年推出五款新 iPhone，在可折叠手机的推广中着眼于中国制造的芯片
text: Apple is planning five new iPhones by 2027 and is considering Chinese memory suppliers as it expands foldable production, reports say.
zh: 据报道，苹果计划到 2027 年推出五款新 iPhone，并在扩大可折叠产品生产时考虑中国内存供应商。

title: M&A is ‘on fire’ as large-cap firms simplify, Citi UK CEO says
title_zh: 花旗英国首席执行官表示，随着大型公司简化，并购正在“火热进行”
text: Citi U.K. CEO Tiina Lee said U.K. M&A is “on fire” as companies simplify and overseas buyers target British assets.
zh: 花旗英国首席执行官蒂娜·李 (Tiina Lee) 表示，随着企业简化流程以及海外买家瞄准英国资产，英国的并购活动“火热进行”。

title: Meta says WhatsApp usernames are safeguarded against scams after India flags cybersecurity risks
title_zh: Meta 称印度标记网络安全风险后 WhatsApp 用户名将免受诈骗
text: Meta has defended its WhatsApp username feature after the Indian government raised cybersecurity concerns.
zh: 在印度政府提出网络安全担忧后，Meta 为其 WhatsApp 用户名功能进行了辩护。

title: Trump says outside funds 'run my money' after disclosure shows billions in 2025 revenue
title_zh: 披露2025年收入数十亿美元后，特朗普表示外部资金“跑了我的钱”
text: The 927-page annual financial disclosure form shows Trump's purchases and sales of hundreds of companies' stocks, including Nvidia, Amazon and Microsoft.
zh: 这份长达927页的年度财务披露表格显示了特朗普购买和出售数百家公司股票的情况，其中包括英伟达、亚马逊和微软。

title: Automakers report mixed U.S. sales results as hybrid vehicles drive market
title_zh: 由于混合动力汽车推动市场，汽车制造商报告的美国销售业绩好坏参半
text: Second-quarter U.S. new vehicle sales show a sharp divide, with automakers offering hybrid models largely outperforming those without them.
zh: 第二季度美国新车销量出现了巨大的分化，提供混合动力车型的汽车制造商的表现基本上优于没有混合动力车型的汽车制造商。

title: Trump administration's limits on student loan forgiveness program are blocked. What to know
title_zh: 特朗普政府对学生贷款减免计划的限制被阻止。要知道什么
text: Trump's policy that narrowed eligibility for a popular student loan forgiveness program will not go into effect, after two federal judges blocked the rule.
zh: 在两名联邦法官阻止该规则后，特朗普缩小受欢迎的学生贷款减免计划资格的政策将不会生效。

title: Treasury Secretary Bessent backs rate cuts but says he understands if the Fed wants to wait
title_zh: 财政部长贝森特支持降息，但表示他理解美联储是否愿意等待
text: Bessent has previously said the Fed should hasten cutting interest rates, calling reductions "the only ingredient missing" for stronger economic growth.
zh: 贝森特此前曾表示，美联储应加快降息，称降息是经济增长强劲的“唯一缺失的因素”。

title: Warren Buffett says he sold Apple too soon and would buy more of it, though not in this market
title_zh: 沃伦·巴菲特表示，他太早卖掉了苹果公司，并将购买更多苹果公司，尽管不是在这个市场
text: Apple remains Berkshire Hathaway's largest holding even after the conglomerate trimmed its stake at the end of last year.
zh: 即使伯克希尔哈撒韦公司去年底减持了其股份，苹果公司仍然是伯克希尔哈撒韦公司最大的持股公司。

title: Nvidia is betting on a trillion-dollar robotics boom. Here is the hidden way to trade it.
title_zh: 英伟达押注机器人技术将迎来数万亿美元的繁荣。这是隐藏的交易方式。
text: CEO Jensen Huang has called humanoid robots a “multitrillion-dollar economic opportunity.”
zh: 首席执行官黄仁勋称人形机器人是“数万亿美元的经济机会”。

title: CoreWeave, Nebius shares tumble as Meta stands to become a fresh threat in the cloud
title_zh: 随着 Meta 成为云领域的新威胁，CoreWeave 和 Nebius 股价暴跌
text: Meta’s reported interest in monetizing its AI infrastructure is leading investors to question the sustainability of neocloud business models.
zh: 据报道，Meta 对将其人工智能基础设施货币化的兴趣导致投资者质疑 Neocloud 商业模式的可持续性。

title: China’s private funds see assets soar by over US$400 billion amid tech boom - South China Morning Post
title_zh: 科技繁荣，中国私募基金资产飙升逾4000亿美元 - 《南华早报》
text: China’s private funds see assets soar by over US$400 billion amid tech boom South China Morning Post
zh: 《南华早报》：随着科技繁荣，中国私募基金资产飙升逾4000亿美元

title: China pledges full support for tech sector with broad range of new policies - South China Morning Post
title_zh: 中国承诺通过一系列新政策全力支持科技行业 - 南华早报
text: China pledges full support for tech sector with broad range of new policies South China Morning Post
zh: 中国承诺通过一系列新政策全力支持科技行业 - 南华早报

title: Best China ETFs to Watch in 2026 - Investing.com
title_zh: 2026 年最值得关注的中国 ETF - Investing.com
text: Best China ETFs to Watch in 2026 Investing.com
zh: 2026 年最值得关注的中国 ETF Investing.com

title: Russia launches massive strike on Ukraine as Poland scrambles jets, Finland restricts airspace
title_zh: 俄罗斯对乌克兰发动大规模打击，波兰紧急起飞飞机，芬兰限制领空
text: The Russian defence ministry said that it launched a "massive strike using long-range precision air, land, and sea-based weapons and attack drones."
zh: 俄罗斯国防部表示，“使用远程精确海基、陆基和海基武器以及攻击无人机发动了大规模打击”。

title: OpenAI proposes 5% stake to Trump administration to ease Washington pressure: report
title_zh: OpenAI 提议向特朗普政府持有 5% 股份，以缓解华盛顿压力：报告
text: Trump said in June that the U.S. taking an ownership stake in AI giants would be "a beautiful thing" and make American public "partners in this revolution."
zh: 特朗普六月表示，美国持有人工智能巨头的股权将是“一件美好的事情”，并使美国公众成为“这场革命的合作伙伴”。

title: Europe wants to rebalance trade with Beijing, but can't quit Chinese air conditioners
title_zh: 欧洲希望与北京实现贸易再平衡，但无法戒掉中国空调
text: An historic heat wave has driven unprecedented demand for Chinese-made air conditioners in Europe, underscoring the tough task Brussels faces in rebalancing trade with Beijing.
zh: 历史性的热浪推动了欧洲对中国制造空调的前所未有的需求，凸显了布鲁塞尔在与北京贸易再平衡方面面临的艰巨任务。

title: Amazon is designing its own AI chips for Echo, Fire TV and future devices, exec tells CNBC
title_zh: 亚马逊高管告诉 CNBC，亚马逊正在为 Echo、Fire TV 和未来设备设计自己的人工智能芯片
text: Amazon hardware chief Panos Panay says the company is designing custom chips for key devices as it experiments with AI gadgets.
zh: 亚马逊硬件主管帕诺斯·帕奈 (Panos Panay) 表示，该公司正在为关键设备设计定制芯片，同时试验人工智能设备。

title: Volkswagen braces for boardroom showdown over historic cost-cutting plan
title_zh: 大众汽车准备就历史性的成本削减计划进行董事会摊牌
text: Volkswagen is poised for a boardroom showdown following reports that the auto giant is weighing up shutting four factories and implementing 100,000 job cuts.
zh: 有报道称，大众汽车正在考虑关闭四家工厂并裁员 10 万人，该公司准备在董事会摊牌。

title: Shares of BYD and Xiaomi surge as June delivery figures fuel optimism
title_zh: 6月交付数据乐观，比亚迪和小米股价飙升
text: Hong Kong-listed shares of Chinese electric vehicle makers surged, after companies posted June vehicle data that helped to buoy investor sentiment.
zh: 在公司发布 6 月份汽车数据有助于提振投资者情绪后，中国电动汽车制造商在香港上市的股票大幅上涨。
